workContent:
At Deloitte’s Tax Open Day, students will gain firsthand exposure to the dynamic world of professional tax advisory. The event is designed to provide participants with a clear understanding of the responsibilities, career pathways, and skills required to succeed as a graduate associate/ intern in our Tax practice.

Key Highlights of the Event:

Career Fast Track Opportunities: Participants will have onsite interviews opportunities & secure Green Passes, accelerating their path to joining Deloitte

Tax Advisory Insights: Learn how Deloitte professionals support clients in navigating complex tax regulations and compliance requirements

Interactive Learning Activity: Join a fun and engaging session designed to broaden your understanding of Deloitte’s Tax service lines and gain practical knowledge in an accessible way

Networking Opportunities: Connect with Deloitte Tax professionals to gain insights into career development and workplace culture

Event Details:
Date: 3rd October 2026 (Saturday)
Time: 09:30 – 13:00
Venue: Deloitte Office, 35/F, One Pacific Place, 88 Queensway, Hong Kong
serviceCondition:
•             Candidates graduating in 2027 or 2028 are preferred 
•             Any disciplines while taxation, accounting, finance, economics, law , Japanese, or a business related discipline preferred 
•             Aspires to be a professional in a very competitive environment and demonstrate strong commitment in the profession
•             Demonstrates proactive learning capability and attitude 
•             Demonstrates ability to comprehend and analyze complex issue in business context and present effectively both in oral and written English
•             Demonstrates ability to manage multiple tasks
•             Be able to communicate effectively and relate with people effectively
•             Demonstrates leadership potential at extra curriculum activities and ability to work as a team player
•             Be proficient in MS Office and other computer software
•             Can be trusted with confidence
•             Opens to constructive critiques on how to improve

By the end of the Tax Open Day, participants will have gained practical skills, built meaningful connections, and understood the pathway to becoming a professional in Deloitte’s Tax practice. With the chance to secure Green Passes and onsite interviews, this event is a gateway to launching a rewarding career.

Application Timeline:
Applications close on 27 September 2026 at 23:59.
Successful registrants will receive confirmation emails by 30 September 2026.
